# Redis

<!-- GENERATED by tools/gen_component_agents.py from xrds/redis.meta.yaml; edit the sidecar, not this file. -->

A Redis cache or shared-counter store, dedicated to one application environment.

## How it is requested

A `components[]` entry in an app's values file; the airframe-application chart renders the XR in the app's namespace. Wire it into the app with `env[].fromComponent` (never hand-write the derived names).

## Outputs

- `host`: `{name}-master.{namespace}.svc.cluster.local`. The master Service's in-cluster DNS name.
- `port`: `6379`.
- `url`: `redis://{name}-master.{namespace}.svc.cluster.local:6379`. host:port only, no credentials embedded (auth.enabled is true on this component, so a connection still needs the password output supplied separately - e.g. as its own env var).
- `password`: Secret `{name}-connection`, key `password`. The Crossplane-composed connection Secret (writeConnectionSecretToRef), not the raw Bitnami chart Secret (which also exists, named `{name}`, key `redis-password` - the connection Secret copies the same value here so every component type has one canonical `<name>-connection` output surface).

## Where named objects come from

- Secret `{name}-connection`: written by Crossplane from the Release's connection details.
- Service `{name}-master`: created by an operator from the composed Release.

## Conditions

Besides Crossplane's Ready and Synced. Reasons are a closed set:

- `ComponentReady`: `RedisReady` (True), `RedisDeploying` (False), `RedisReleaseFailed` (False), `RedisProvisioning` (False).

## Verify a live XR

```
tools/airframe-verify redis <namespace>/<name> [--context CTX]
```

Read-only. Steps, after the implicit `xr-synced` check:

- `xr-ready` (condition): The Redis XR's ComponentReady condition has reason RedisReady.
- `secret-exists` (secretKeys): Secret {name}-connection exists in the app namespace and has a non-empty password key.
- `reachable` (tcp): {name}-master accepts a TCP connection on 6379, through kubectl port-forward, so it proves the server is listening, not that the app namespace's NetworkPolicy admits the app.

## Editing this composition

- Edit `compositions/redis/templates/`, never the inline blocks in `composition.yaml`: `python3 tools/build-compositions redis` splices them.
- `python3 tools/test_compositions.py --update redis` regenerates `example/expected/`; review that diff like code, it is the behaviour change.
- `python3 tools/test_sidecars.py` fails if a template change breaks a name this sidecar promises.
- The image is pinned to bitnamilegacy; the upstream Bitnami images moved. Use hasKey, not default, for booleans: Sprig's default turns an explicit false into the default.
- The {name}-connection Secret comes from the Release's connectionDetails; an output key that is not a connection key is caught by tools/test_sidecars.py.

Contract: `tools/airframe-capabilities verify redis`; schema: `xrds/redis.yaml`.
